Community.authPrompt: Sign in to manage and submit resources

Statuses.pendingTooltip: Your resource is currently pending approval and won't be publicly available. We'll let you know when it's approved. Please contact an admin if you have questions.
Statuses.pendingeditTooltip: Your resource is currently pending approval and your changes won't be publicly available, but the previous version will be unless you choose to hide it. We'll let you know when it's approved. Please contact an admin if you have questions.
Statuses.approvedTooltip: Your resource has been approved and will be publicly shared with the community. It can still be edited as needed but may require reapproval.
Statuses.hiddenTooltip: Your resource has been hidden from the public page. You may restore it at any time without requiring approval.
Statuses.deniedTooltip: Your resource has been denied approval and won't be publicly available. Edit the resource and make any requested adjustments to resubmit it for approval. Please contact an admin if you have questions.
Statuses.unknownTooltip: An error occurred retrieving the status of this resource.

Submission.mainTooltip: The main landing page for your static app, often "index.html". This page should pull in other required assets using relative URLs. Dynamic apps, php, or other more complicated frameworks are not supported.
Submission.otherTooltip: Other assets (images, scripts, style sheets, etc) required by your static app. These should be pulled in by your main page using relative URLs.
Submission.otherPrompt: Please explain what the conent of your resource should be and we'll help get it working. Be sure to fill out the "Contact" field as well in case we have additional questions.
